title: Partir, let's explore France like a local !
author: ICI
description: Welcome to “Partir”, French word for leave, go, start a journey. This podcast is all about helping you make the most of your week-ends in France, packed with insider tips you won’t find in a guidebook. So come along and let’s explore France like a local ! Vous aimez ce podcast ? Pour écouter tous les épisodes sans limite, rendez-vous sur Radio France.
